QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_50

question.text: Regulatory safeguards on Incentive Fee mis-alignment in AIFs include:

answer.text: Mandatory disclosure in PPM, clawback provisions, HWM and Hurdle thresholds, Sponsor continuing interest
Requiring SEBI approval for each fee payment

explanation.text: The Logic: Source-backed mitigants of incentive-fee mis-alignment include PPM/fund-document disclosure of fee bases, sponsor continuing interest (skin-in-the-game), hurdle and high-water-mark thresholds, and clawback provisions. Together these structural and governance controls align manager incentives with investor outcomes. The Trap: Options A, B, and D overstate the regulatory regime: SEBI does not impose a 5% cap, does not ban incentive fees, and does not require per-payment approval. Note: The keyed option is a composite list of disclosure and governance safeguards rather than a single rule.
